objectives.name: OBJ_PRI
objectives.label: Primary objective
objectives.text: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of single ascending oral doses of CTX-101 in healthy adult participants.

endpoints.name: EP_PRI_1
endpoints.label: TEAEs
endpoints.text: Incidence and severity of treatment-emergent adverse events.

endpoints.name: EP_PRI_2
endpoints.label: Safety parameters
endpoints.text: Change from baseline in vital signs, 12-lead ECG parameters (including QTcF) and clinical laboratory tests.

objectives.name: OBJ_SEC
objectives.label: Secondary objective
objectives.text: To characterise the single-dose plasma pharmacokinetics of CTX-101.

endpoints.name: EP_SEC_1
endpoints.label: PK parameters
endpoints.text: Plasma CTX-101 Cmax, tmax, AUC0-last, AUC0-inf and t1/2.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: INCL01
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Inclusion 1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Healthy male or female participants aged 18 to 55 years inclusive at screening.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: INCL02
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Inclusion 2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Body mass index (BMI) of 18.0 to 32.0 kg/m2 inclusive and body weight of at least 50 kg at screening.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: INCL03
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Inclusion 3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Healthy as determined by medical history, physical examination, vital signs, 12-lead ECG and clinical laboratory tests at screening and Day -1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: INCL04
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Inclusion 4
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Women of childbearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test at screening and Day -1 and agree to use highly effective contraception.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: INCL05
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Inclusion 5
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Able and willing to provide written informed consent and comply with study procedures.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EXCL01
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Exclusion 1
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: History or presence of clinically significant cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrine, hematological or neurological disease.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EXCL02
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Exclusion 2
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: QTcF greater than 450 ms (males) or greater than 470 ms (females) at screening or Day -1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EXCL03
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Exclusion 3
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: ALT or AST greater than 1.5 x ULN, or total bilirubin greater than ULN at screening.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EXCL04
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Exclusion 4
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Positive test for hepatitis B surface antigen, hepatitis C virus RNA, or HIV-1/2 antibody.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EXCL05
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Exclusion 5
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Positive urine drug screen or alcohol breath test at screening or Day -1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EXCL06
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Exclusion 6
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Use of any prescription or over-the-counter medication within 14 days before dosing.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: EXCL07
eligibilityCriterionItems.label: Exclusion 7
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participation in another interventional clinical study within 30 days or 5 half-lives before dosing.
